subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue any of these native core/API surfaces now: batched file/search inputs, AI-callable context blocks, or runner-enforced submitted plans?
rationale: The request changes core tool schemas, context/session persistence semantics, config surface, and model-runner enforcement policy, while VISION.md only partially aligns and warns against heavy orchestration or optional capability that can live through plugin/API seams.

options.title: Split for design review
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor separate designs for any surface they want to pursue.

options.title: Route narrower pieces
options.body: Track manual context clearing in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45503 and runtime guardrails in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97371 while leaving native batching for a separate decision.

options.title: Decline core orchestration
options.body: Close the umbrella as out of scope if maintainers decide native batching, AI context blocks, and plan enforcement should remain plugin or external workflow territory.

recommendation.title: Split for design review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor separate designs for any surface they want to pursue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on update_plan and strict-agentic behavior, which makes them the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
